docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $7,006.81 FILED BY DELECLUSE, SERGE (ADRIEN) AS TO DEFENDANT DAUGIRDAS, MARIUS ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUN-10-2011 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (FEE FOR SERVICE:$NONE GIVEN) SERVED MAY-04-2011, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT DAUGIRDAS, MARIUS
SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JUN-10-2011 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JUN-10-2011 BY DONALD S. MITCHELL. APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF ONLY. CLERK: S. VANTREE. NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUN-10-2011 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF DELECLUSE, SERGE (ADRIEN) RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT DAUGIRDAS, MARIUS $7,006.81 PRINCIPAL, $75.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $7,081.81, DEFENDANT NOT PRESENT. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
ORDER OF EXAMINATION ISSUED AS TO DEFENDANT DAUGIRDAS, MARIUS HEARING SET FOR OCT-13-2011 AT 11:00 AM IN DEPT 506

SMALL CLAIMS OEX CALENDAR OF OCT-13-2011 IS CONTINUED TO OCT-27-2011 AT 11:00 AM IN DEPT. 506. APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT. DEFENDANT TO COMPLETE THE SC-133 FORM GIVEN TO HIM TODAY IN COURT. DEFENDANT IS TO BRING 3 MONTHS OF ALL FINANCIAL INFORMATION NEXT COURT DATE. DEFENDANT(JD) WAIVES SERVICE. JUDGE PRO TEM: ROBERT SHEPPARD. CLERK: S. VANTREE. NOT REPORTED. (506)

SMALL CLAIMS OEX CALENDAR OF OCT-27-2011 IS CONTINUED STIPULATION OF THE PARTIES TO DEC-01-2011 AT 11:00 AM IN DEPT. 506. PARTIES AGREED TODAY THAT THE DEFENDANT(JD) WILL LIQUIDATE ASSETS (VEHICLE) TO SATISFY THE JUDGMENT AND REQUESTS A 1 MONTH CONTIUANCE. PLAINTIFF(JC) AGREES TO THIS. IF NO APPEARANCE ON DECEMBER 1, 2011 AT 11:00, THE ORDER OF EXAMINATION WILL BE DISCHARGED. PLAINTIFF WILL FILE A SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT WITH THE COURT. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: S. VANTREE. NOT REPORTED. (506)

SMALL CLAIMS OEX CALENDAR OF DEC-01-2011 IS CONTINUED PER STIPULATION OF THE PARTIES TO JAN-12-2012 AT 11:00 AM IN DEPT. 506. DEFENDANT WILL TRANSFER TITLE TO HIS 2002 BMW TO PLAINTIFF WHO WILL ATTEMPT TO REPAIR THEN SELL THE CAR. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: M. DE LUNA. NOT REPORTED.
SMALL CLAIMS OEX CALENDAR OF JAN-12-2012 IS OFF CALENDAR - NO APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF. APPEARANCE BY DEFENDANT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: P. NATT. NOT REPORTED. (506)
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT, FULLY SATISFIED, AS TO DEFENDANT DAUGIRDAS, MARIUS
